title: EUROTTER: collaborative science for spatial animal ecology
descr: EUROTTER is a European network dedicated to the Eurasian otter (Lutra lutra). Initially bringing together wildlife managers, field naturalists, and researchers studying the species' spatial ecology via telemetry data, the network pools tracking datasets and expertise from across the continent. This collective effort aims to deepen our understanding of otter movements, habitat use, and home-range dynamics across contrasting landscapes. Over time, Eurotter will grow beyond telemetry into a broader forum covering all questions related to otter management and conservation. Through a data-driven, evidence-based approach, its goal is to consolidate research on the species and foster collaborative, European-scale projects capable of answering questions that cannot be resolved at a single study site.
